name: Kerepes (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow blue border, charged at the centre with the town arms of Kerepes: a blue and red shield with a coach, a tree, a sheaf of grain and tools, above a yellow scroll inscribed 1148 KEREPES 1998.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
